title: Core Glossary: Mass Spectrometers — Signature Edition — Signature Method
description: Core Glossary: Mass Spectrometers — Signature Edition — Signature Method: the working vocabulary of Mass Spectrometers — Signature Edition: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo. The Signature edition: the JAH system's original reference on Mass Spectrometers. Mass spec identifies: ionization makes ions, analyzers sort, detectors count. Vacuums and expertise.
definition: Core Glossary: Mass Spectrometers — Signature Edition — Signature Method — the working vocabulary of Mass Spectrometers — Signature Edition: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo..
key_points: Blank: A sample with none of the analyte, measuring background.
Standard: A sample of known concentration for calibration.
Matrix: Everything in the sample except the analyte.
LOD: Limit of detection: the smallest amount reliably seen.
LOQ: Limit of quantification: the smallest amount reliably measured.
Throughput: Samples processed per unit time.
Uptime: The fraction of time the instrument is usable.
IQ/OQ/PQ: Installation, operational and performance qualification.
21 CFR Part 11: The FDA rule for trustworthy electronic records.
